name: axme-code
description: Persistent memory, decisions, and safety guardrails for Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, Continue, Roo Code, Windsurf, and VS Code chat agents

axme.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `axme-code` binary. Leave empty to auto-detect via `$PATH`, `~/.local/bin/axme-code`, or platform standards. Override only if you have a non-standard install.

axme.contextMode.markdownDescription: **Deprecated for v0.0.3** — this setting is read-only and reflects what's in your workspace's `.axme-code/config.yaml`. Change the mode via `AXME: Enable semantic search` / `AXME: Disable semantic search` commands or via the sidebar toggle (those actually install/uninstall the runtime + reindex).

axme.enableHooks.markdownDescription: Register safety hooks (`preToolUse` / `postToolUse` / `sessionEnd`) at activation. When ON, force-pushes / dangerous bash / file-write violations are blocked across every project on this machine.

axme.auditorMode.markdownDescription: How the session auditor extracts memories/decisions from chat transcripts. `cooperative` (default) instructs the agent to save inline during the chat — use it with `axme_begin_close`/`axme_finalize_close` when you wrap up. `background` runs a detached LLM after every chat using your own API key — more thorough, but billed separately.

walkthroughs.title: AXME Code — Getting Started
walkthroughs.description: Set up persistent memory, decisions, and safety guardrails for your AI agent in four steps.

steps.title: Extension installed
steps.description:
The AXME Code extension is active. The Activity Bar now has an AXME icon — that's your monitor for memories, decisions, backlog, and the current chat session.

**AXME is configured per-project**: each repo you open needs a one-time setup (step 2 below). When you update AXME in the future, reload Cursor with `Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R` to apply.
[Open AXME sidebar](command:workbench.view.extension.axme)

steps.title: Set up the workspace
steps.description:
Run setup once per project. Recommended: ask the agent in chat — no extra API key needed, everything runs on your Cursor subscription.

**How**: click the button below, the prompt copies to your clipboard. Then open or focus a Cursor chat (Cmd/Ctrl+L), paste (Cmd/Ctrl+V), hit Enter. The agent scans the repo and saves architecture decisions / patterns / safety rules through MCP tools.

[Copy setup prompt → paste in chat](command:axme.askAgentSetup)

Alternative (uses your own API key, billed separately):
[Run setup with API key](command:axme.setup)

steps.title: Pick your auditor mode
steps.description:
Cooperative (default): zero extra cost — the agent saves inline during the chat, then you ask it to close the session at the end.
Background: uses its own API key, runs after every chat for thorough extraction (billed separately).
[Open AXME settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22axme.auditorMode%22%5D)

steps.title: Open your first AXME-aware chat
steps.description: Open a fresh chat tab. The agent will see your AXME tools in its toolbox and call axme_context automatically at startup. Try asking it to make any change — safety hooks will block dangerous commands, and the sidebar will start showing live token / memory counts.

steps.title: Semantic search — opt-in for large knowledge bases
steps.description:
AXME runs in **full mode** by default — every memory + decision body is loaded into the agent at session start. Zero setup, simple.

For larger KBs (>50 entries, or decisions with long rationale): **semantic search mode** loads only the catalog at startup, agent fetches bodies on demand via smart similarity search. Saves significant tokens.

The trade-off: a one-time ~770 MB download (`@huggingface/transformers` runtime). It's reversible any time.

[Enable semantic search now](command:axme.enableSemanticSearch)

Leave it for later? Just skip this step — full mode keeps working. You can enable from the sidebar (Knowledge base → Search mode) or `AXME: Enable semantic search` whenever.
